steps.now: 兔儿爷 smells a spirit by the water. Walk west from the 鼓楼 square along 烟袋斜街 to 后海 — or ride line 8 one stop to 什刹海.
Ask the old man fishing by the lake what he saw last night.
The fox went towards 景山. Cross 银锭桥, walk along 北海 and climb 景山 to the pavilion — someone up there sees everything.
“故宫西北角附近” — near the north-west corner of the palace: the corner tower 角楼, down the south side of 景山. Go after dark; the bench on 景山 is a good place to wait.
The fisherman has run out of bait 鱼饵. The corner shop 小卖部 on 南锣鼓巷 sells it.
Bring the bait to the fisherman at 后海.
Take a boat out on 后海 (30 元) — ask the boatman.
